name: Shual
title: One of Asher's descendants
summary: Shual (also known as Shaul or Shual) is mentioned in the Bible as a descendant of the tribe of Asher. He appears in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles. His role is primarily genealogical, and he is part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Asher's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shual is listed among the descendants of Asher in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles, which documents Israel's tribal lines.

keyEvents.title: The land of Shual
keyEvents.description: The name Shual also appears as a geographical area in connection with the Philistines' raiding expeditions during Saul's time, where a detachment went toward the land of Shual.

keyEvents.title: Part of Asher's tribal inheritance
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Asher, Shual is linked to the broader narrative of Israel's twelve tribes and their place in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The tribe's warrior traditions
keyEvents.description: Asher's descendants, including Shual's line, were counted among skilled warriors and family heads who were mustered for military service.
